title: mentha × sativa subsp. acutifolia
intro: Mentha × sativa subsp. acutifolia, commonly known as Corn Mint, is a hybrid subspecies of mint native to Europe and western Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Corn Mint include its ability to ease nausea, alleviate headaches, and soothe respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Corn Mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
